topic: Breath series 4b: Cyclic sighing, breathe-along short version, repeat (off grid)
caption:
A one-minute pause, three times over: breathe along with these cyclic sighs whenever the day gets full.

Take a full, slow inhale through your nose, add one short, sharp sniff at the top, then let it go in one long, slow exhale through your mouth. Go at whatever pace feels comfortable.

If you feel light-headed, go back to your usual breathing. Research on this technique has excluded people with heart disease, glaucoma, a history of seizures or pregnancy, so check with your doctor first if any of these apply to you.

Want the research behind it? The full guided version is on our profile @equal_psychology.

Save this for another time.
